name: VA Pinned Component Expiration
description: Notifies a user when their pinned virtual appliance cluster component is about to expire.
subject: Reminder: Pinned VA cluster component $processName $processVersion expires on $versionPinExpiry
body:
Pinned VA cluster component expiring soon

Dear recipient,

This is a reminder that a pinned virtual appliance (VA) cluster component is approaching its expiration date.

Pinned version: $processVersion

VA cluster component: $processName

Expiration date: $versionPinExpiry

Time remaining: $timeToExpiry

Pinned VA versions do not receive updates. Falling behind on certain VA updates may limit access to SailPoint support for the VA.

You can manage the upcoming expiration in one of the following ways:

  • Do nothing — If you no longer need a specific version, allow the pin to expire and the cluster will automatically update to the latest version.
  • Request an extension — If you need more time on the pinned version, contact SailPoint Support to request an extension.
  • Request pin removal — If you no longer need the pinned version, contact SailPoint Support to remove the pin.

Thank you,
The $PRODUCT_NAME Team
